title: Versions
hint: Every publication is a version: compare, download or roll back.
notFoundText: This theme does not exist (any more).
loadFailed: The versions could not be loaded
monacoFailed: The diff view could not be loaded
rollbackText: This publishes the CSS of v{n} again as a new version v{next}. The history stays intact and the draft gets the same CSS.
rollbackDraftWarning: The draft has unpublished changes: they will be replaced.
rolledBack: v{source} is live again as v{n}.
resetText: The draft gets the CSS of v{n}. Unpublished changes in the draft will be lost; nothing is published.
changedMeanwhile: The theme changed in the meantime. Reloaded; try again.
